scope: S115 Mod-original regional ambient gossip: region-scoped lines with condition vocabulary, CN/EN parity, links to existing notes; no rewards, no task progress, no knowledge leaks
rules: 按地区写：只谈本区生活、景物与旧事，不替台本当事人发言
不含奖励、不推进任务、不给库存；闲聊不改任何结算
同一事实不与台本冲突：只作路人视角，可含糊、可错传
条件词表固定：any/night/band:+1/band:-1/after:<task>；after 只重评未来台词

lines.speaker: 船工
lines.cn: 你闻着这股味儿没有？渠水退下去的时候，底下那层旧泥全翻上来。
lines.en: Smell that? When the culvert drops, the old silt turns up from underneath.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 围城那阵子，我们连渠里的水都省着用。现在说起来像别人的事。
lines.en: During the siege we rationed even the culvert water. It sounds like someone else's story now.

lines.speaker: 卫兵
lines.cn: 夜里渠口风大。灯要是灭了，别摸黑走，站着等人来。
lines.en: The wind at the culvert mouth is heavy at night. If your lamp dies, stand still and wait for someone.

lines.speaker: 商贩
lines.cn: 码头那几家肯给我留货位，是看我这几年没欠过账。
lines.en: The dock stalls hold space for me because I have never left a debt here.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 那晚上的事过去之后，敲钟的人走路都轻了。你听得出。
lines.en: After that night, the bell-ringer walks lighter. You can hear it.

lines.speaker: 渡工
lines.cn: 水位看桩，别看天。天说下雨，桩说什么时候能过。
lines.en: Watch the post, not the sky. The sky promises rain; the post says when you can cross.
lines.link: 区域_R02_布林东侧河口与渡口

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 磨坊停转以后，村里磨面要走到下一个村。走一趟就是一整天。
lines.en: Since the mill stopped, grinding means walking to the next village. A whole day gone.
lines.link: 地点设计卡_R02_布林东侧河口与渡口

lines.speaker: 旅人
lines.cn: 夜里别在荒宅过夜。门是开的，里面的响动不是风。
lines.en: Do not sleep in the empty house at night. The door is open, and what creaks inside is not the wind.

lines.speaker: 商贩
lines.cn: 桥板修好以后，我这车能多跑一趟。多跑一趟，孩子就多一双鞋。
lines.en: With the second plank fixed I can make one more run. One more run buys the child another pair of shoes.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 渡口的人认得你的脸了。认脸的地方，价钱好谈一点。
lines.en: The ford men know your face now. Where they know your face, prices bend a little.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 今年的田有一半没种。不是懒，是没人手，也没种子。
lines.en: Half the fields went unsown this year. Not laziness - no hands, no seed.

lines.speaker: 牧人
lines.cn: 界石后头那片草场，谁先到谁下陷。规矩是规矩，人是人。
lines.en: The meadow past the boundary stone: first come, first snares. The rule is the rule; people are people.

lines.speaker: 养蜂人
lines.cn: 烟一起，蜂就散。田一荒，人也散。道理是一样的。
lines.en: Smoke rises, the bees scatter. Fields go fallow, people scatter. Same lesson.

lines.speaker: 农人
lines.cn: 夜岗安生以后，牲口回圈早了。狼还在，只是不进棚。
lines.en: Since the night watch settled, the stock comes home early. The wolves are still there; they just keep off the pens.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 入冬前别往草场深处走。陷是旧的，狼是新的。
lines.en: Before winter, keep out of the deep meadow. The snares are old; the wolves are new.

lines.speaker: 石工
lines.cn: 关楼的石头是从坑里一块块抬上来的。抬石头的人没留下名字。
lines.en: The gate stones were carried up one by one. The carriers left no names.
lines.link: 地点设计卡_R04_王廷关隘与边城

lines.speaker: 卫兵
lines.cn: 过关要看文书，看不了的就看人。看得多了，人比纸准。
lines.en: At the pass we read papers, and when papers fail we read people. Read enough and people beat paper.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 夜里崖上落石。听见响别抬头，往墙根靠。
lines.en: Rock falls off the cliff at night. If you hear it, do not look up - get to the wall foot.

lines.speaker: 石工
lines.cn: 军需账的事传开了以后，坑边来看热闹的人多了。看热闹不出工钱。
lines.en: Since the quartermaster ledger got around, more people come to stare at the pit. Staring pays no wages.

lines.speaker: 旅人
lines.cn: 守门的肯跟你多说两句，说明你上次没给他们添乱。
lines.en: The gate men talk a while longer with you - that means last time you caused them no trouble.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.speaker: 护理者
lines.cn: 湿地边上的路要横着走。竖着走，脚下就是坑。
lines.en: Cross the wetland edge sideways. Straight ahead is a hole.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 封条是给外人看的。住在这儿的人，看的是风。
lines.en: The seals are for outsiders. Those who live here watch the wind.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 夜里有狗叫就回屋。狗比人先知道谁在田埂上走。
lines.en: If the dogs bark at night, go inside. Dogs know who walks the dikes before people do.

lines.speaker: 护理者
lines.when: after:台本_DT16_愿意继续治疗的人
lines.cn: 愿意继续治的人多了一个，药还是那些药。省着用。
lines.en: One more person chose to keep treating, and the medicine is the same medicine. We stretch it.
lines.link: 台本_DT16_愿意继续治疗的人

lines.speaker: 旅人
lines.cn: 村里肯给你指近路，是把你当熟人了。别把近路说给外人。
lines.en: The village shows you the short path now; that means you count as a local. Do not pass it on.

lines.speaker: 药农
lines.cn: 山道上的石堆是路标，不是坟。别把路标踢散。
lines.en: The stone piles on the trail are signs, not graves. Do not kick them apart.

lines.speaker: 矿工
lines.cn: 进洞先敲木头。木头响得实，你就还能往里走。
lines.en: Knock the timber before you go in. If it rings solid, you may walk further.

lines.speaker: 旅人
lines.cn: 修院方向夜里不点灯。你要是看见灯，那不是修院。
lines.en: No lamps burn toward the monastery at night. If you see one, it is not the monastery.

lines.speaker: 药农
lines.cn: 驿馆的药送到以后，山道上问药的人少了一半。
lines.en: After the inn got its medicine, half the people asking on the trail stopped asking.

lines.speaker: 乡民
lines.cn: 山里人认熟不认官。你多来两趟，比带什么文书都管用。
lines.en: Mountain folk trust habit, not papers. Two more visits beat any letter you carry.
